headline: Changes to city debt management policy approved 3-0, removing pension bond language and setting public art and land bank funding by bond issuance.
summary: The meeting covered changes to the city's debt management policy, which passed 3-0. The changes add referendum thresholds, remove pension obligation bond language, and tie public art and land bank contributions to general fund bonds. Members also discussed the city-schools MOU, the police department building, and the expo center.
decisions: Passed the debt management policy changes as presented, 3-0.
discussion: Public art and land bank funding: Members asked how much the change would shift the contributions and whether the original purpose still fits, and a broader review of arts funding was suggested.
City-schools MOU status: Members discussed a document describing city and school operations, with costing and legal review still pending and a December target.
Remote and in-person meetings: Members supported returning to some in-person meetings, especially for budget talks, while considering hybrid options for staff.
Police and expo center projects: Members asked for design and timing details on the police building, and the expo center project was described as further behind.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll take a motion to pass these changes as presented and as in the agenda. So moved. Second. ... Council pellet's here. Yes. Council for here. Yes. And I'm yes. Motion passes.

decision_titles: Changes to the city debt management policy
